job.job_description:
Job Summary

Responsible for mechanical inspection, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Wind Turbines as per OEM standards.

Key Responsibilities
Inspect wind turbine towers and physical integrity.
Troubleshoot hydraulic and variable speed systems.
Perform maintenance as per OEM practices.
Inspect gearboxes and generators.
Replace worn or malfunctioning components.
Maintain maintenance records and reports.
Qualifications & Skills
Diploma/Degree in Mechanical Engineering
Experience in turbines preferred
Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills
Knowledge of gearbox & hydraulic systems
Ability to work at heights
Job Details
Department: Operations & Maintenance - Mechanical
Location: Wind Project Sites
Experience: 2-5 and 5-8 Years in Wind Turbine Mechanical O&M
Key Success Metrics
Reduced mechanical failures
Improved turbine reliability
OEM compliance adherence
Accurate maintenance documentation

Note: Candidates need to be open for the Site Locations PAN India as per Business Requirement.
